newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- New cement plant for Southern Province Cement Co to start production next week with an annual capacity of 1.2 million tonnes of clinker, official says.
- The Islamic Development Bank approves two loans to Pakistan worth $35.2 million, raising the amount extended by the bank to Pakistan to $1.5 billion, official says.
- Saudi date production to reach 620,000 tonnes by the year 2000.
- Saudi Arabia's imports from Moslem and Arab countries in 1995 were worth 11.5 billion riyals.
